scope: Selected pinned source closures for the native build factory
contract: Default preparation and verification remain exhaustive.
Selected paths must be exact root-tree gitlinks at the requested parent commit; verify their recursive descendants.
Check parent files/index and selected sources; preserve unrelated gitlinks and explicitly report wholeRepositoryQualified=false.
Existing source/heavy locks remain in force; this does not bypass a running job.
Plan, prepare, run and detached durable-job fingerprint/status preserve the selected source scope.

validation.fixtures: Real disposable local Git repositories and native job fixtures; selected pin, dirty/index, ignored collision, symlink, recursive closure and inaccessible sibling cases.

limits: The legacy preparation already fetching M3 remains under its lock; selecting sources affects new requests.
No Bun/Next engine artifact is qualified by source-closure tests.
